annotations.title: Current ledger head and its bound end marker

description: Return the current head of the JIDEC/NENRIN ledger: entry count n, the head hash, and the end marker bound into the chain (jidec-head-v1) with the recipe to recompute it. Compare it with a head you saw earlier to detect truncation or rewrite.
name: nenrin_ledger_head

lookup.description: ok = the ledger was read and the record exists. absent = the ledger was read and there is no such record. A read that FAILED never appears here: it comes back as a tool error (isError: true), so a consumer can never mistake this server's own failure for a statement about the ledger's contents.

source_url.description: The public ledger URL that returned this body. Fetch it yourself to compare.

title: Current ledger head and its bound end marker
